name: shcportal_generate_otp
description: Sends OTP for Soil Health Card Portal authentication. Does NOT verify OTP or create session. Fails if Aadhaar is invalid or mobile not registered.

name: shcportal_verify_otp
description: Verifies OTP and returns session_token for SHC Portal. Does NOT retrieve reports. Fails if OTP is expired or incorrect.

name: shcportal_search_reports
description: Searches for available Soil Health Card reports for a farmer. Returns list of reports with sample IDs, dates, land parcels, and report_status. Requires session_token. Does NOT retrieve full report details — use shcportal_get_report_details. Fails if no reports exist. May return multiple reports across years and land parcels.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: shcportal_get_report_details
description: Retrieves full details of a specific SHC report including nutrient values, recommendations, and lab details. Report must be in 'available' or 'downloaded' status. Requires session_token. Does NOT download the report file — use shcportal_download_report. Fails if report_id is invalid or report is not yet available (sample still under testing).

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

report_id.description: Unique identifier of the SHC report.

name: shcportal_check_sample_status
description: Checks the processing status of a soil sample. Returns sample_status ('registered', 'collected', 'in_transit', 'under_testing', 'report_ready') with timestamps. Requires session_token. Does NOT generate or retrieve the report. Fails if sample_id is invalid. Can be used to check if report is ready before attempting download.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

sample_id.description: Unique identifier for a soil sample.

name: shcportal_download_report
description: Initiates download of a Soil Health Card report. Transitions report_status to 'downloaded'. Report must be in 'available' status. Requires session_token. Does NOT generate reports. Fails if report is not available, report_id is invalid, or download encounters a system error.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

report_id.description: Unique identifier of the SHC report.

name: shcportal_get_nutrient_values
description: Retrieves specific nutrient analysis values from a generated report. Values include nitrogen, phosphorus, potassium, organic carbon, pH, and micronutrients. Lab-measured and immutable. Requires session_token. Does NOT provide recommendations. Fails if report is not generated or nutrient data is partial.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

report_id.description: Unique identifier of the SHC report.

name: shcportal_get_fertilizer_recommendation
description: Generates fertilizer recommendations based on SHC test results and target crop. Recommendations depend strictly on lab-measured soil data. Requires session_token. Does NOT apply fertilizers. Fails if no report exists or crop type is unsupported.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

report_id.description: Unique identifier of the SHC report.

name: shcportal_get_historical_reports
description: Retrieves all historical SHC reports for a farmer. SHC is typically generated once every 2 years. Requires session_token. Does NOT create new reports. Fails if no historical reports exist.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: shcportal_filter_reports_by_land
description: Filters SHC reports for a specific land parcel across all available years. Requires session_token. Does NOT generate reports. Fails if land_parcel_id is invalid or no reports exist for that parcel.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

land_parcel_id.description: Unique identifier for a land parcel.

name: shcportal_get_lab_details
description: Returns details of the laboratory assigned to test the soil sample. Requires session_token. Does NOT change lab assignment. Fails if sample_id is invalid or no lab assigned.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

sample_id.description: Unique identifier for a soil sample.

name: shcportal_raise_grievance
description: Raises a grievance about SHC Portal. Valid categories: 'report_not_found', 'incorrect_values', 'lab_delay', 'wrong_land_mapping', 'download_issue'. Must check report/sample status first. Requires session_token. Fails if category is invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: shcportal_track_grievance_status
description: Tracks a SHC Portal grievance. Requires session_token. Does NOT raise new grievances. Fails if grievance_id is invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.
